LanguageData.PWW_SetMeltdownTip: Off: at 100 % heat the fission reactor shuts itself down. On: it explodes and toxic fallout covers the map for 3 days.
LanguageData.PWW_SetHydroWinter: Hydro plants weaker when the river freezes
LanguageData.PWW_SetHydroWinterTip: Below −2 °C outside a hydro plant gives only 40 % of its power.
LanguageData.PWW_SetAutoLow: Diesel auto-start: switch on below {0} % stored energy
LanguageData.PWW_BreakerTripped: A short circuit hit the grid, but the circuit breaker tripped in time – no explosion, no fire. The part of the grid behind the breaker is now without power until you switch the breaker back on.
LanguageData.PWW_HydroGround: The cells that are not on moving water need firm ground.
LanguageData.PWW_NeedSea: Must stand within 3 cells of the sea.
LanguageData.PWW_Meltdown: The fission reactor overheated and exploded. Toxic fallout is coming down over the whole area.
LanguageData.PWW_ScramDesc: Shut the reactor down at once. It cools down and can be switched on again later.
LanguageData.PWW_AutoStartDesc: Switches the generator on when the grid's batteries drop below {0} % and off above {1} %. Without batteries it runs while the grid needs more power. Thresholds in the mod settings.
LanguageData.PWW_StonecutterIdle: Waiting for stone chunks next to it.
LanguageData.PWW_GridOverviewDesc: Production, consumption and stored energy of this power grid, with the last 24 hours.
LanguageData.PWW_GridWait: The graph fills in once per in-game hour.
LanguageData.PWW_Grid24h: last 24 hours · green production · orange consumption · blue stored
